|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Your Black Sun agents at same and related sites may not have their forfeit reduced. Adds 1 to maneuver of Mist Hunter. Once per game you may ▼ 4-LOM (without a permanent weapon) here. Immune to attrition < 3.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Zuckuss (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 2, slip 22 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “P 2. Your Black Sun agents at same and related sites may not have their forfeit reduced. Adds 1 to maneuver of Mist Hunter. Once per game you may ▼ 4-LOM (without a permanent weapon) here. Immune to attrition < 3.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 4 FORCE-SENSITIVE”. Deploy 3, forfeit 4. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•22” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf], Internet Archive 5 December 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS7-22-Zuckuss-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Zuckuss (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 22), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. ''Mist Hunter'' is maneuver +1. Your Black Sun agents at same and related sites may not have their forfeit reduced. Once per game, may deploy non-[[Permanent Weapon]] 4-LOM here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
